prompt:
Create ONE finished illustration. Use case: stylized-concept. One original adult female character, a single vertical 2:3 full-body character artwork. Text input only. Sections: 1 fixes the rendering style for every genre; 2 fixes the character; 3 and 4 change only the costume, equipment and scene. The genre must never change the rendering style of Section 1.

1. RENDERING STYLE — PREMIUM KOREAN MMORPG ILLUSTRATION (FIXED ACROSS ALL GENRES)
Premium Korean MMORPG official character illustration with an elegant idealised semi-realistic face, exceptionally refined dimensional modelling and precise material rendering. A polished 2.5D painted game illustration with convincingly three-dimensional forms and delicately finished surfaces. Use rich, clear local colours, deep luminous midtones and selective highlights. Hair has weight, sculpted flowing masses and individual fine wisps. Polished metal has sharp selective reflections; silk has soft directional lustre; leather has quieter broad reflections. The materials must look distinctly different. No visible contour outlines, no flat cel shading, no photographic skin texture, no plastic doll finish, no exaggerated eyeliner, no oily skin or overall glossy sheen. Maintain excellent facial clarity and colour richness without a washed-out veil, muddy shadows, excessive bloom or an overall blue colour cast.
FACIAL DESIGN LOCK: model the eyelids, eyeballs, nose bridge and nose tip, lips, cheeks and jaw with continuous nuanced shading. The face remains soft and beautiful, with clean matte-satin skin and subtle natural highlights. Preserve the specified face shape, eye shape, skin colour and adult maturity.
GENRE LOCK: wuxia, high fantasy and mecha change only the design of the costume, equipment and setting. The face, skin, hair rendering, eye size, lighting on the face and painting finish stay exactly the same in every genre.

2. CHARACTER — LIU BEI, FEMALE INTERPRETATION (SAME IN EVERY GENRE)
An original beautiful East Asian adult woman, a female interpretation of Liu Bei (유비) of the Three Kingdoms — the benevolent founder of Shu Han, who swore sisterhood in the Peach Garden. Her nature: benevolence and humility that win hearts, humble straw-sandal beginnings under imperial Han blood, long jade earrings as her mark of fortune, the twin swords of the Peach Garden oath, tears shed for her people. Her femininity and body volume express this character. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. Face: a small, refined, beautiful adult face — oval face, almond-shaped eyes, realistically proportioned eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward, soft rounded brows, straight narrow nose, full wide lips, a bare, makeup-free face; a soft, gentle warmth; expression: a warm, gentle look with a faint smile. Skin: warm beige skin. Hair: muted, low-saturation warm chestnut-brown hair, long straight hair, center-parted bangs framing the face. Eyes: amber eyes. Face and both eyes clearly visible. Body: approximately 7.5 heads tall, a natural neck, long shapely legs — curvy — long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure, with soft, rounded volume at bust, hips and thighs; never thin, flat or boyishly straight; hips and thighs stay within natural, realistic proportion. One head, two arms, two legs; two natural human hands with five fingers each and correct arm and hand connections. The costume in Section 3 fits this body closely enough to show the waist and the curve of bust and hips, while keeping chest and pelvis covered; her beauty and feminine curves stay immediately legible beneath the costume.

3. COSTUME — MECHA (far-future science fiction)
a command-type mecha — crowned head unit with an antenna crest, cape-like binder wings, heavy chest plating with an emblem core, a flagship back unit; faction frame: jade-green and white plating with imperial-gold trims, organic layered armor like overlapping leaves, a resilient all-terrain frame, warm green glow lines. The plating covers her from neck to feet and reads as solid engraved metal armour, not cloth, painted like heavy fantasy plate. Overall silhouette: a large ring halo behind her head and a tall crown-like head unit, with long hanging shoulder plates — a ceremonial, elegant shape — only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely. Tailored to her curves, with a coherent flowing silhouette and exquisitely crafted fine detail rather than clutter; avoid giant pauldrons, oversized hips, dense bulky armour, a closed helmet and gratuitous dangling ornaments. Palette: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade. Motifs drawn from her nature: benevolence and humility that win hearts, humble straw-sandal beginnings under imperial Han blood, long jade earrings as her mark of fortune, the twin swords of the Peach Garden oath, tears shed for her people. Signature item: a pair of matched twin swords in one double scabbard, drawn whole at full scale — the item and its tip entirely within the image. EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
4. SCENE
Vertical 2:3 full-body composition, one complete figure from the top of her hair to the soles of her footwear, with comfortable breathing room above, below and at both sides. Eye-level perspective, a gentle three-quarter turn, an elegant relaxed contrapposto, shoulders open toward the viewer, direct composed gaze; one hand holds her signature item naturally, the other bare hand holds nothing, relaxed slightly forward and separated from her silhouette so the complete hand is visible; both arms and both hands completely visible and correctly attached, five natural fingers each; she holds nothing else — no cup, goblet or other props. Make the face sufficiently large and meticulously resolved while retaining the full body. Background: inside a vast glass dome over terraced gardens, a ringed gas giant hanging in the sky above, softly out of focus; it supports the character and does not compete. Lighting: neutral soft daylight on her face and front body, with a restrained warm grazing highlight on selected metal edges. Crisp, intricate main character, atmospheric background. No text, labels, UI, logos, watermark, collage, additional people, extra limbs, cropped hands or cropped equipment.
